title: Cloud backend: AWS Amplify Gen2
description:
Deploy the same data model to AWS: AppSync GraphQL, DynamoDB, S3 (`apricitusFiles`), and Cognito with Google sign-in, restricted to allowed emails (members, curators, admins). The web app runs against it, and libraries move between local and cloud with `transfer`.

**Gated on the user** (apricitus-e28a12): AWS account and profile, the Google OAuth client, allowed emails, and approval to deploy (it costs money).

Design: `design/storage.md` §1.1, §2.1 (the SDL snapshot), §4 and §5 (transfer).

## Definition of done
- The corpus is green on the sandbox, including unauthorized cases.
- Google sign-in works end to end.
- Round trip local → cloud → local is identical.
